purpose: Audit the exact affine residue reporter, Euclidean floor sums and sharp affine threshold. Not a scaling or factoring-performance benchmark.
timing_scope: The 50 seconds include manifest/input generation, all audit cases and reference enumeration. A TERM at 55 seconds has 2 seconds to preserve evidence before KILL. Source writing and literature reading precede the finite run.
case_order: One floor-sum block, then ascending s, listed N order, one affine-threshold block and four reporter boxes per N.
generator: Deterministic integer formulas. No factors, primality filtering, random seed, or selected outcome.
affine_grid: For each s,N: r=floor(5s/2)-1 and floor(5s/2), all odd a in [1,2^r), x=0,1,2. Compare gcd(second_difference,R^5) with 2^min(2r+1,5s).

report_boxes.clipped-balanced: I=[R^3/2,min(R^3-1,floor(sqrt(N)))]; J=[max(R^3/2,ceil(N/R^3)),min(R^3-1,floor(2N/R^3))]. These are the balanced-box intersections of the P=R^3/2 Card1 box.

reference: After the reporter completes, enumerate all odd p in I, compute q=N*inverse(p) mod R^5, and test J. Reference work is diagnostic and recorded separately.
metrics: all reported pairs and actual-factor subset
elapsed seconds including checks; not a solver timing
rejection_criterion: Any floor-sum discrepancy, incorrect second difference valuation, omitted/spurious/duplicate pair, or incorrect full-box patch count rejects correctness. Deadline yields incomplete audit, never success. Stop after first failed/deadline case and retain all remaining cases as unstarted.
complexity_criterion: No finite acceptance of an exponent. The derived D/2=2^(floor(5s/2)-1) mandatory full-box patch visits already reject this explicit-patch construction for R^(6/5) or R polylog R time.
preservation: Exclusive-create cases.json before attempts; line-buffered events.jsonl records freeze/start/result; results.json retains all 61 statuses and counters. Never overwrite or rerun this protocol silently.
scope: Only H011-inverse-* files; no lab imports, shared code, Lean, packages, factor libraries or external solver.
